This Mr. Market is highly emotional. His prices fluctuate wildly, driven by his current mood—sometimes euphoric, sometimes fearful—rather than the intrinsic value of the business itself. A key insight is that you are never under any obligation to accept his daily offers. His emotional swings can, in fact, create opportunities.
